purpose: Document first-party registry/map discovery, viewer/service evidence, bounded anonymous request outcomes, and safety limits.
assessment: Official Sivas Municipality and TKGM sources evidence local cadastral/map custody and public map entry points, but no safe anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was obtained in this attempt.
registryAssessment: Sivas Municipality's Akıllı Şehir ve Kent Bilgi Sistemleri Müdürlüğü and the TKGM Sivas Regional Directorate are local/municipal cadastral-service custodians. General TKGM MEGSİS prose was treated as national context only.
queryOutcomes: English and Turkish discovery queries were run separately and recorded in the city record; they found the official viewer and municipal services listed there.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier if independently verified
requestOutcomes: TKGM shell retrieval failed DNS in the shell and returned 502 through web retrieval. Municipal pages were discoverable, but no bounded WMS/GetCapabilities or parcel feature response was verified. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS exception was used.
geometryDecision: No sample GeoJSON written because no complete unchanged native parcel polygon with a verified safe native identity was available.
uncertainty: A viewer outage, map extent limitation, absent exact-point hit, timeout, or login wall is not evidence of citywide absence. The native schema, field mapping, CRS/axis order, anonymous access policy, and service coverage remain unresolved.

runtimeAssessment.reason: No independent anonymous ID-plus-geometry response; packet does not qualify an adapter or enable runtime.
